facts.display: Individual and joint brokerage accounts, Traditional and Roth IRAs, revocable trust accounts and custodial (UTMA) accounts. No mutual funds or bonds except through ETFs.

facts.quote: We offer individual and joint brokerage accounts, Traditional and Roth Individual Retirement Accounts (IRAs), revocable trust accounts, and custodial (UTMA) accounts. We do not offer mutual funds or fixed income securities, except in the form of an ETF.

facts.display: Administrative fees apply, such as regulatory and exchange fees and some paper document fees. Robinhood Gold is an optional paid subscription.

facts.display: $0 commissions for U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs in self-directed accounts traded in the app or on the website.
facts.quote: Commission-free trading refers to $0 commissions for Robinhood Financial self-directed individual cash or margin brokerage accounts that trade U.S. listed and OTC securities (including ETFs and closed-end funds), and their options via the app or website.

facts.display: $0 for options on U.S.-listed stocks and ETFs. Index options have a per-contract fee (see other trading costs), and regulatory fees apply.
facts.quote: Commission-free trading refers to $0 commissions for Robinhood Financial self-directed individual cash or margin brokerage accounts that trade U.S. listed and OTC securities (including ETFs and closed-end funds), and their options via the app or website.

facts.display: Index options: $0.50 per contract, or $0.35 with Robinhood Gold. Regulatory trading fees are added to some trades.
facts.quote: Non-Gold Rate: $0.50 per options contract (buys and sells) Gold Rate: $0.35 per options contract (buys and sells)

facts.display: Yes, in many of the stocks, ETFs and ADRs it offers.

facts.display: Educational content and tools about trading and the markets.

facts.display: App-based and self-directed. Offers one-time ETF portfolio recommendations (minimum $20) and does not monitor accounts.
facts.quote: Portfolio Recommendations are only available for certain ETFs with a minimum investment of $20.00 … Robinhood Financial does not provide account or investment monitoring services.

facts.display: No charge for its one-time portfolio and stock lending recommendations. Advisory services from affiliates were not reviewed.
facts.location: Form CRS, "What fees will I pay?"
facts.quote: nor does it charge for the point in time Portfolio Recommendations or Stock Lending Recommendations we make.

facts.display: Yes. Interest is charged on money you borrow in a margin account.
facts.location: Form CRS, "What fees will I pay?"
facts.quote: Margin Interest: Robinhood charges a percentage on funds you borrow to purchase securities in a margin account.

facts.display: 5.25% for settled margin balances up to $50,000, as of September 16, 2026. Rates are lower for larger balances and can change without notice.

facts.quote: Settled Margin Balance Up to $50,000 … Margin interest rate 5.25% … Margin rates shown are as of September 16, 2026.
